# Mosaic & stained glass

Breaks the image into irregular cells (a Voronoi mosaic), each filled with one color and outlined in lead, like stained glass or tiles.

<EffectDemo effect="mosaic" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { mosaic } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/mosaic';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(mosaic({ preset: 'cathedral' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.cellSize = 18`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type      | Default     | Range     | Description                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `cellSize`  | number    | `18`        | 4 – 80 px | Average size of a cell.                         |
| `jitter`    | number    | `0.9`       | 0 – 1     | Irregularity of the cells: 0 is a square grid.  |
| `lineWidth` | number    | `0.08`      | 0 – 0.4   | Width of the lead lines, relative to a cell.    |
| `lead`      | hex color | `'#15141a'` |           | Color of the lines between cells.               |
| `glow`      | number    | `1.15`      | 0.5 – 2   | Brightness of the glass, as if lit from behind. |
| `seed`      | integer   | `0`         | 0 – 99    | Picks a different pattern of cells.             |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                       |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cathedral` | `cellSize: 26`, `lineWidth: 0.12`, `glow: 1.4`                 |
| `tiles`     | `jitter: 0.2`, `lineWidth: 0.06`, `lead: '#e6e1d6'`, `glow: 1` |
| `fine`      | `cellSize: 8`, `lineWidth: 0.05`                               |
| `crystals`  | `cellSize: 40`, `lineWidth: 0.02`, `glow: 1.2`                 |

Apply one with `mosaic({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/mosaic`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Worley, A cellular texture basis function, 1996 (jittered Voronoi cells).

## Related

- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
- [Kuwahara (painterly)](./kuwahara) — An edge-preserving smoothing filter that turns detail into flat, brushy patches, like an oil painting: each pixel takes the calmest neighboring region’s average.
- [Halftone](./halftone) — Print-style halftone screens: four rotated CMYK screens, a single ink, or additive RGB, drawn as dots, lines or squares sized by the tone under each cell.
